name: production boundary: a long PR-body heredoc then the run's own branch push is allowed

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a PR body written through a heredoc past 3 KiB is text, so the push of the run's own branch after it is allowed" \
  "allow" "$(prod_verdicts_for "$prod_pr_body_then_own_branch_push")"

stdin:

## Summary

The production boundary read a long PR-body heredoc as a line past what it can read, so the run's own
`git push -u origin oso-run/<name>` was refused as a production deploy. The lexer now reads up to 32 KiB,
so `vercel --prod` is still denied while the push of the run's own branch goes through.

- `core/src/shell/lexer.ts`: the input bound is 32768 bytes; the brace and prefix paths are linear.
- `core/src/hosts/envelope.ts`: the command field is always decoded; the lexer bound alone governs.
- Fixtures pin both sides of the edge, a multibyte variant included, and "quoted $HOME" text stays text.
